content:
Sometimes a small change can make a big difference, and for Apple users who have a large number of pre-released apps, the latest TestFlight update is a perfect example.

Apple has just updated TestFlight for iPhone, iPad, Mac and other devices. The new version 4.3 adds a search bar for quickly finding the app you want to use.

Comparing it with version 4.2.2, you can clearly see that TestFlight now has a search bar added at the bottom of the iPhone and at the top of the Mac sidebar.

If you only have a few beta apps, you might think this change is pretty basic, but for users with a large number of beta apps, the search function has been long-awaited.

This update also displays more apps in the "Previously Tested" category, so it's believed that the usual bug fixes and performance improvements are related to this change.

Apple's TestFlight app can be downloaded from the App Store and supports iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, and Apple TV.
